verdict.rationale: Deel documents a public REST API covering core operations such as contract creation, and an MCP server whose tools map to API operations across contracts, people, payroll, time off and cost calculations, so a broad programmatic surface exists. Nothing in the evidence claims or demonstrates that the API matches everything the UI can do. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, a full endpoint inventory showing coverage of all UI workflows (payroll runs, onboarding, equipment, etc.), and independent hands-on corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
